headline: EQT Beats Q3 EPS Estimates but Falls Short on Total Revenue
summary: Natural gas producer EQT delivered third-quarter earnings per share that beat Wall Street forecasts, though quarterly revenue missed market expectations.
why: EQT is the largest natural gas producer in the United States, serving as an operational benchmark for Appalachian basin output and North American gas realizations.

impacts.name: EQT Corporation
impacts.why: Earnings per share outperformance was offset by top-line revenue coming in below consensus forecasts.
